en: From the edge of the woods you can make out the small shapes of the Ruffian guards moving about in the camp. You see a break in the trees which can afford a safe approach to their tents!
zh-Hant: 站在樹林邊緣，你看見營地裡幾名惡棍守衛正在走動。樹木間有一道缺口，可以安全接近他們的帳篷！

en: At first sight of the abandoned keep a shiver runs through your body. You maneuver for a better view, and can make out the shapes of the bandits along the walls.
zh-Hant: 乍見廢棄的堡壘，你不禁打了個寒顫。你換個位置仔細觀察，辨認出沿著城牆活動的強盜身影。

en: As you approach the village, all is quiet. It's almost as if the creatures you came to defeat have left. But faintly you hear the low mumurs of their savage tongue from within.
zh-Hant: 接近村莊時，四周一片寂靜。你要消滅的怪物似乎已經離去，但裡面隱約傳來牠們用野蠻語言低聲交談的聲音。

en: Climbing down the side of the cliff face you stand looking up at an array of holes carved into the cliffs by time and weather. Now the decision is;"Which one to take?"
zh-Hant: 你沿著峭壁攀下，抬頭看見歲月與風雨在岩壁上鑿出的許多洞穴。現在要決定的是：「走哪一個？」

en: After wandering through the hills for many hours you finally come upon the remains of a huge beast which has been cooked on an equally large campfire. At once you hear a giant roar.
zh-Hant: 在丘陵間遊蕩了數小時，你終於發現一頭巨獸的殘骸，牠曾在同樣巨大的營火上被烤熟。突然，一聲巨吼傳來。

en: From the rim of one of the hills surrounding the valley below, you see the spidery forms of Binderaks running about in what once was the druid's keep. Slowly, you approach its walls.
zh-Hant: 站在環繞山谷的丘陵邊緣，你看見蜘蛛般的賓德拉克在昔日的德魯伊堡壘裡四處奔跑。你緩緩靠近城牆。

en: You follow the water's edge for miles but no sign of the hamlet can be found. Rounding a corner of the beach you suddenly spy one of the outermost buildings. Quietly, you approach.
zh-Hant: 沿著水岸走了數哩，你仍看不到小村莊的蹤影。繞過海灘的轉角時，你突然瞥見最外圍的一棟房屋，於是悄悄靠近。

en: The forest engulfs your party like a gigantic blanket with barely the light of day betraying its cover. Stumbling on with rays of sunlight as your guide you run into a group of huts.
zh-Hant: 森林像巨大的毯子般包住隊伍，日光幾乎無法穿透。你循著幾束陽光踉蹌前行，終於碰上一群小屋。

en: The size of the old keep astounds you as you make your way towards the bridge. Looking more closely now, you see the bridge is being guarded by these foul beasts; Muck Things.
zh-Hant: 走向橋梁時，古老堡壘的規模讓你驚嘆。仔細一看，橋上守著那些污穢的怪獸：污泥怪。

en: The hills are difficult to traverse this time of year and when you do reach the fortress, you are almost breathless. From inside its walls you hear the sound of metal being hammered.
zh-Hant: 這個季節的丘陵難以跋涉，抵達要塞時，你幾乎喘不過氣。城牆內傳來敲打金屬的聲音。

en: You draw nearer to the cave mouth and attempt to peer inside. As the tunnel digs into the cliff face, it is lit by torches which flicker ominously bidding you to enter.
zh-Hant: 你靠近洞口，試著向裡窺探。隧道深入峭壁，沿途火把不祥地閃爍，彷彿在召喚你進去。

en: In the distance along the bay you see the towering fortification once used to repel any pirate ships which sought to raid the village below. Rising, you approach it slowly.
zh-Hant: 沿著海灣望向遠方，你看見高聳的防禦工事，過去用來擊退企圖劫掠下方村莊的海盜船。你起身，緩緩靠近。

en: You move down the long corridor of the cave and ponder your long trip to solve this quest. You wonder if it was worth the trouble as you hear an evil chanting coming from ahead.
zh-Hant: 沿著洞穴的長廊前進，你回想起為完成任務而走的漫長旅程。前方傳來邪惡的吟唱，你不禁懷疑這一切是否值得。

en: The town seems too quiet as you move down the cobblestone path to its heart. A heart whose only beat is the steady drum of your boots on the ancient road.
zh-Hant: 沿著鵝卵石小路走向鎮中心時，四周安靜得出奇。這顆城鎮的心臟，只有你的靴子踏在古道上的規律聲響。

en: You followed the clues to the quest carefully, but somehow you feel you must've gone the wrong direction as only a bare coast greets you. Then a noise like the rush of a tide surrounds you.
zh-Hant: 你仔細追尋任務線索，眼前卻只有空曠的海岸，讓你覺得一定走錯了方向。忽然，潮水奔湧般的聲音包圍了你。

en: You had heard about the tournaments they used to hold in Stonesthrow, but being here and seeing the old grounds reminds you of your jousting days. But now a new foe greets you.
zh-Hant: 你曾聽說斯通斯羅舉辦的比武大會。如今站在舊會場，讓你想起騎槍競技的歲月；但此刻迎接你的，是新的敵人。

en: You wander the coast for some time and come upon a large castle looming in the distance. Just off the coast to the east is anchored a ship from which hangs a skull and crossbones.
zh-Hant: 沿海岸走了一段時間，你看見遠方聳立著一座大城堡。東側近海停泊著一艘船，船上懸掛著骷髏交叉骨旗。

en: You have been on the trail of Orcs for some time now, hoping to catch the main raiding party. Suddenly, you see a large keep in the distance across the river and make for it.
zh-Hant: 你已追蹤半獸人一段時間，希望趕上劫掠的主隊。突然，河對岸遠處出現一座大堡壘，你朝它前進。

en: You are lost in a storm and wander aimlessly for days until you come upon an odd-shaped keep in the center of an island. Hoping for the best, you approach the stone walls cautiously.
zh-Hant: 你在暴風雨中迷失，漫無目的地走了幾天，終於在島嶼中央發現一座形狀奇特的堡壘。抱著一線希望，你小心靠近石牆。

en: Wandering the valley you are reminded of the many battles waged here. In the distance you see an ominous sight, a moat with a fortress rising out of it. An awful stench emits from it.
zh-Hant: 穿過山谷時，你想起這裡曾發生的許多戰役。遠方出現不祥的景象：一座要塞從護城河中聳起，散發出可怕的惡臭。

en: Having heard about the many great evils which live in the Sheller Ridge, you move with caution towards the encampment. The Ettin's size astounds you, still you must prevail!
zh-Hant: 聽聞謝勒山脊棲息著許多強大的邪惡生物，你謹慎地靠近營地。雙頭巨人的體型讓你震驚，但你仍必須獲勝！

en: You make your way over the broken terrain of of the Thanakesh hills. Suddenly, in the distance you see what looks like tremendous whirling dust devils. You advance carefully.
zh-Hant: 你越過塔納凱什丘陵崎嶇的地形。突然，遠方似乎出現巨大的旋轉塵柱，你小心翼翼地前進。

en: As you approach the Cliff Troll village, you can see the ugly forms of this creature pacing the bridges which hold the entrance to their home. Their growl is unsettling.
zh-Hant: 接近懸崖巨魔的村落時，你看見醜陋的巨魔在守住家園入口的橋上踱步。牠們的低吼令人不安。

en: The Sodden hills are a dismal place to journey through. All around are signs of sacrifices made in Pildar's name. Mustering your wits, you continue on. Suddenly you see a hole up ahead.
zh-Hant: 穿越濕泥丘陵是一段陰鬱的旅程，四處都是以皮爾達之名獻祭的痕跡。你振作精神繼續前進，忽然看見前方有個洞口。

en: An extremely pungent smell assaults your nose. Suddenly, you hear a strange noise.
zh-Hant: 一股極其刺鼻的氣味襲來。突然，你聽見一聲奇怪的聲響。

en: You approach the scene of an ancient battle. Bodies of the fallen lie rotting in the sun.
zh-Hant: 你接近一處古老的戰場，死者的屍體在烈日下腐爛。

en: You feel the ground tremble and see dust rising in the distance. A hoarse yell is heard.
zh-Hant: 你感到地面震動，看見遠方揚起塵土，接著聽見一聲嘶啞的吼叫。

en: The hairs on your neck stand and you get the feeling you're being watched by unseen eyes.
zh-Hant: 你頸後的寒毛豎起，感覺有看不見的眼睛正盯著你。

en: The clang of metal echoes over the far ridge. Suddenly, you spy the glint of steel.
zh-Hant: 金屬碰撞聲越過遠方的山脊。突然，你瞥見鋼鐵的閃光。

en: Low, grumbling voices can be heard off in the distance. It sounds like Walruses arguing.
zh-Hant: 遠方傳來低沉的咕噥聲，聽起來像海象在爭吵。

en: The snap of splintering wood draws you to a halt. Listening, you hear a low mumbling.
zh-Hant: 木頭碎裂的聲響讓你停下。側耳傾聽，又傳來低聲的咕噥。

en: A high-pitched scream echoes through the vale. You hear a rustling in the bushes nearby.
zh-Hant: 尖銳的叫聲迴盪在山谷裡，附近的灌木叢傳來沙沙聲。

en: A large boulder tumbles down the path you're on. It narrowly misses, but another soon follows.
zh-Hant: 一塊巨石沿著你走的小路滾下，險些擊中你，很快又滾來另一塊。

en: You halt for a moment and listen carefully. On the breeze you hear a faint, deep growl.
zh-Hant: 你停下片刻，仔細傾聽。微風送來若有似無的低沉吼聲。

en: A peculiar row of poles dances left and right on a hill to the east. The poles grow ever taller.
zh-Hant: 東方山丘上，一排奇怪的長桿左右搖擺，而且越來越高。

en: A battle cry pierces the air. Stillness follows. You scan the horizon but see nothing.
zh-Hant: 一聲戰吼劃破空氣，隨後一片死寂。你掃視地平線，卻什麼也看不到。

en: Heavy footfalls shake the ground, and the clang of steel against chain is heard.
zh-Hant: 沉重的腳步震動地面，鋼鐵碰撞鎖鏈的聲音隨之傳來。

en: You ride through the scene of a recent battle. Around you the dead and dying moan.
zh-Hant: 你騎馬穿過一處剛結束戰鬥的地方，周圍的死者與垂死者發出呻吟。

en: The earth around you is rough and broken. The grass is torn up as if dug by huge hands.
zh-Hant: 四周地面崎嶇破碎，草皮翻起，彷彿被巨大的手掌挖過。

en: You think you hear a voice so you pull to a stop. Standing in the saddle you look around.
zh-Hant: 你似乎聽見人聲，於是勒馬停下，站起在馬鐙上環顧四周。

en: The stench of the bog attacks your senses. The slime around you begins to bubble up.
zh-Hant: 沼澤的惡臭侵襲你的感官，周圍的黏液開始冒泡。

en: The thick underbrush makes traveling slow. You see the tall grass move in the distance.
zh-Hant: 濃密的灌木讓行進緩慢，你看見遠方的高草正在搖動。

en: The splintering of wood causes you to pull up. In the distance, a tree falls to the ground.
zh-Hant: 木頭碎裂的聲音讓你勒馬停下，遠方一棵樹倒在地上。

en: You notice the spiders are awfully large in this area. Suddenly, a form bolts towards you.
zh-Hant: 你發現這一帶的蜘蛛大得嚇人。突然，一道身影向你疾衝而來。

en: You come upon a cottage which is engulfed in flames. Yet, the trees around it are untouched.
zh-Hant: 你遇見一間被火焰吞沒的小屋，周圍的樹木卻毫髮無傷。

en: A loud chopping sound is accompanied by a deep voice singing in a tongue unknown to you.
zh-Hant: 響亮的劈砍聲伴著低沉歌聲，唱的是你聽不懂的語言。

en: Suddenly, clouds cover the sky and a sick laughter begins. You can't tell its origin.
zh-Hant: 突然，雲層遮住天空，一陣病態的笑聲響起，你卻無法辨認來處。

en: You ride upon the scene of a great battle. The fallen lie moaning on the field around you.
zh-Hant: 你騎馬來到一處大戰場，倒下的人散落四周，在地上呻吟。

en: The water looks so calm as you stare across it. Suddenly, the surface begins to boil.
zh-Hant: 你望向水面，水看起來十分平靜，突然卻像沸騰般翻湧。

en: The wind seems to have picked up and you have to squint to make out the path.
zh-Hant: 風似乎變強了，你必須瞇起眼睛才能看清道路。

en: The crack of stone on stone is followed by simian laughter. The gibbering grows louder.
zh-Hant: 石頭互擊的脆響後傳來猴子般的笑聲，吱喳聲越來越響。

en: A gentle breeze cools your brow, yet in the distance a tree whips wildly back and forth.
zh-Hant: 微風拂過額頭帶來涼意，遠方一棵樹卻猛烈地來回搖晃。

en: The trees around you are covered in thick moss."Perfect cover!" you say to yourself.
zh-Hant: 周圍的樹木覆滿厚厚的苔蘚。「絕佳的掩護！」你心想。

en: A cloaked figure can be seen on the far hillock. As you ride up it waves a hand in greeting.
zh-Hant: 遠方的小丘上站著一名披斗篷的人。你騎馬靠近時，對方向你揮手致意。

en: A smouldering campfire is an ominous sight in this remote place. You approach, cautiously.
zh-Hant: 在這偏遠之處，悶燒的營火是不祥之兆。你小心翼翼地靠近。

en: A terrible cry echoes through the vale. It is soon followed by an even more horrifying silence.
zh-Hant: 可怕的叫聲迴盪在山谷裡，接著是一片更令人恐懼的寂靜。

en: Off in the distance you can see smoke twirling in the air. You begin to smell incense.
zh-Hant: 遠方的煙霧在空中盤旋，你開始聞到薰香的氣味。

en: Approaching some smoke, you spy a group of monks chanting. They see you and rise to greet you.
zh-Hant: 接近煙霧時，你看見一群僧侶正在吟唱。他們發現你，便起身迎接。

en: You come upon the scene of a tremendous battle. Bodies of the fallen lie about the field.
zh-Hant: 你來到一處慘烈的大戰場，死者的屍體散落各處。

en: You see a cloaked figure bent over an injured man. She comes towards you and smiles.
zh-Hant: 一名披斗篷的人正俯身照看傷者。她帶著微笑走向你。

en: You feel the thunder of hooves and see dust rising in the distance. The noise grows louder.
zh-Hant: 你感到雷鳴般的馬蹄聲，看見遠方塵土飛揚，聲音越來越響。

en: As you watch, hundreds of Brettle Regulars ride past you and head towards the horizon.
zh-Hant: 數百名布雷特爾正規騎兵從你身邊馳過，朝地平線奔去。

en: Attempt to ride away?
zh-Hant: 要騎馬離開嗎？

en: Riding skillfully, you leave the unknown behind!
zh-Hant: 你騎術高明， 把未知拋在 身後！

en: You cannot ride away.
zh-Hant: 你無法騎馬離開。

en: Will you be healed?
zh-Hant: 要接受治療嗎？

en: Will you partake?
zh-Hant: 要接下嗎？
